params.1273: Deal with the pact member in the final catacomb chamber.
params.1292: Completing this Task will take you one step further in the Blood Pact quest.
params.1274: Warriors are best dealt with using magic.
params.1275: Equip the staff you took from the mage; it will provide you with a source of air runes.
params.1276: Click on the Wind Rush spell in your magic spellbook to set it as your attack, if it is not already.
